timingEvidence.interpretation: Recorded movie request intervals include neutral worker step, draw update, indexed-column observation, CDP, multiple renders and recorder. This is not FPS or measured function attribution. Initial front/launch counts and chosen fronts differ.

findings.detail: Every uncached analyticAt builds current and both finite-difference full contours. Library calls sampleBoundedC with velocity=false, so provider optional fixed-parameter recursion is NOT the runtime cause; equivalent redundant work is in library analyticShape(seconds +/- dt), including moving carrier. Each resolved full sample solves 60 guards, 120 arc bounds and 60 face bounds.

profileTimes, documented without building profile, calls full analyticAt at authoredTD. On a cold parameter key it builds final carrier once for lifecycle then current plus two derivative samples: four full contours and a 35-roof impact solve if provider event cache misses. Even a warm clock cache/query miss rebuilds three contours solely to return scalar clocks.

Query and lifecycle Maps cap64, FIFO insertion eviction; hits do not refresh. Survey all fronts precedes refinements/planning and loft rows; observed142-149 output rows already exceed64, although distinct parameter key count is not recorded. Continuous footHeight/depth and time make exact keys numerous. Clock eviction may cause repeated final root+event work; provider event Map128 separately keys exact final geometry. No cache miss rate measured.

Drawing takes fluidAlong/up, and writes cap transport0; frameBlend sheet reads only final contour/sheetExists. Adjacent immediate frameBlend should normally hit the same query, so do not count it as another guaranteed full rebuild. It still copies256 floats and brackets again.

Each live physics point queries current contour and prospective impact contour, then computes current/projected void and impact jet area. Prospective impact area is age-independent at fixed exact parameters, but is recomputed in each slice; it must remain separate from current void/live-water weighting. jetMotion queries full profiles twice just to read byte-preserved crest32, even though pointAt32 already has exact lightweight path.

New shape correctly derives sheet thickness/sky/throat from actual blended contour rather than raw per-case tables. This adds per-row nearest-segment work; cannot replace it with stale raw tables or nominal T without changing visuals. Exact per-query derived result reuse is possible, not measured dominant here.

minimalOpportunities.invariants: Identical metric lip64 and tipAlong/up. Root construction cannot affect cap64; preserve current full contour validation and do not introduce arbitrary RAW fallback.

minimalOpportunities.invariants: Never publish fake zero/stale cap velocity. Contact needs actual cap transport; drawing and analytic jet flow use fluid metadata.

minimalOpportunities.change: Use existing pointAt32 for CrashCurve.jetMotion crest stencils; retain exact metric F32 point semantics/clock stencil. Cache prospective overturn result only at exact provider parameters, independently from current weighted void.
